hudson.tasks.Shell.command:
# first run: Aug 19, 2026 # orig from Zenodo: 1676575787.tar.gz (https://zenodo.org/records/13320513) # renamed to: BSizeD4NAmeHemiptera.tar.gz
cd /var/www/html/eol_php8_code/update_resources/connectors
### OK 1of4: This will add higherClassification in taxon.tab and rebuild the DwCA. With carry-over of other extensions. ### source is: BSizeD4NAmeHemiptera.tar.gz ### generates FILENAME-with-hC.tar.gz #php dwca_utility.php _ '{"resource_id": "BSizeD4NAmeHemiptera", "task": "gen_hC_using_ancestry"}' #using kingdom, phylum, class, order, family, genus
### OK 2of4: This use gnparser one name at a time. Not entire file. #php run_gnparser_dwca.php _ '{"resource_id": "BSizeD4NAmeHemiptera-with-hC"}' #OK gen neo4j_1
### OK 3of4: Start matching taxa php match_taxa_2DH.php _ '{"resource_id": "BSizeD4NAmeHemiptera-with-hC_neo4j_1", "AncestryIndexVer": "new"}' #OK gen +_eolID exit 0 ### ends here, no taxon match at all. Process stops here.
### OK 4of4: Convert taxon.tab, use EOLid value for taxonID. ### REMINDER: Multiple scinames with different taxonIDs have the same canonical thus will have the same EOLid php use_EOLid_as_taxonID.php _ '{"resource_id": "BSizeD4NAmeHemiptera-with-hC_neo4j_1_eolID"}' # gen BSizeD4NAmeHemiptera_finale
php analyze_MoF.php _ '{"resource_id": "BSizeD4NAmeHemiptera_finale"}' ### generates BSizeD4NAmeHemiptera_finale_analyzed.tar.gz
### rename cd /var/www/html/eol_php8_code/applications/content_server/resources cp BSizeD4NAmeHemiptera_finale_analyzed.tar.gz BSizeD4NAmeHemiptera_TraitBank_1_0.tar.gz ls -lt BSizeD4NAmeHemiptera_finale_analyzed.tar.gz ls -lt BSizeD4NAmeHemiptera_TraitBank_1_0.tar.gz rm -f BSizeD4NAmeHemiptera_finale_analyzed.tar.gz
